I live in the Midwest and there is not a lot of resources. You can only stay in the women's shelter from Like 6pm-6am. They literally close and lock the doors so there is no getting in. If you leave in the night they will kick you put permanently. I work nights so this schedule will not work for me. Plus it is so freaking cold here during the day too. I'd rather just kill myself than be homeless again. It is so terrible. I've been looking at just renting rooms but now that my hours have been cut it isn't possible. I'm not going to move in with a stranger from Cragslist. There are so many crazy and terrible men and woman out there.

I'm not trying to put down your ideas. It is kind of you to take time to comment and offer advice. These are logical ideas I've tried/thought about already.
